_comment: Pre-registered held-out test sets for the clean benchmark (script/clean_bench.py). Labels follow the clean-set rules (pyleos/tests/clean_set.json: IUPAC ionic approximation, Allen electronegativity, homonuclear bonds split equally) and were committed before any test calculation existed, so they cannot have been tuned to results. A case is scored only once its 'dir' points at the recomputed data; dir = null means the calculation has not landed.

test_regression._comment: The 12 clean-set cases whose archived data had unlocalised (stray) WFs. Element references come from pyleos/tests/reference_os.json and site specs from clean_set.json; the archived data is never scored for this split. Recomputation: v1 oxides re-Wannierised with gpuw90 from the archived overlap matrices (git 2f14831^); v3 cases re-exported from VASP (LWRITE_MMN_AMN) and re-Wannierised with gpuw90.

test_homonuclear._comment: New non-magnetic compounds with homonuclear bonds and unambiguous IUPAC labels. Every element pair passes the clean-set convention filter (Allen |dchi| >= 0.15 and Allen/Pauling agree on the order). Site specs use the clean-set syntax; the count rule for BaS3 distinguishes the central S (2 S neighbours) from the terminal S (1). Structures: experimental, sources to be registered here before computing.

bas3.note: trisulfide S3(2-): terminal S -1, central S 0

li2o2.note: Foppl crystal, P63/mmc (the archived li2o2 was an isolated molecule)

si2h6.note: disilane; Allen and Pauling both put H above Si

dev_fix._comment: Recomputations that change a dev case rather than add a test case.

rb2cucl4.change: ISPIN = 2 rerun (Cu d9); restores per-atom Cu scoring
